thread:
elena (product): quick sync — we need a ship-ready error surface for chat, embeddings, rerank, and function-calls. finalizing before next minor. can we align on classes + launch gates?

jordan (eng): +1. propose a simple, actionable taxonomy: 1) client-fixable (validation/auth) 2) transient (rate/infra/model warmup) 3) permanent/server (internal failures). map to HTTP + client guidance. short and deterministic.

elena (product): yep. product wants explicit "what the client should do" per class (retry/backoff/drop/prompt-fix) and gated by SDK/Docs changes.

jordan (eng): sketch mapping: 
```
# error_class -> behavior -> http
CLIENT_FIXABLE -> surface user error, 4xx (400/422/401) -> no retry; include `error_hint`
TRANSIENT_RETRYABLE -> exponential backoff, 429/503/504 -> include Retry-After and `retryable:true`
PERMANENT_SERVER -> log + surface generic 5xx, do not auto-retry; include `request_id` and `support_contact`
```
Also: include `error_code` enumerations (e.g. VALIDATION_ERROR, RATE_LIMIT, MODEL_UNAVAILABLE, KVCACHE_CORRUPT, INTERNAL) and `recommended_action` tokens for SDKs.

pranay (eng-ml): for MODEL_UNAVAILABLE (model-host OOM / slot contention) we should return 503 with body: `error_code: MODEL_UNAVAILABLE`, `available_variants: ["gptx-1-small", "gptx-1-quant" ]` plus `fallback_allowed: true/false`. SDKs can auto-fallback to variant when `fallback_allowed:true` — but make fallback opt-in. also include `model_version` and `latency_sample` so product can detect regressions.

lisa (devex): SDK implications: expose typed Error object: { code, class, retriable, retry_after, details } and helper `shouldRetry(err)`. default SDK behavior: respect Retry-After for 429, exponential jittered backoff for 503 if `retriable`. we will add a major-minor opt-in flag `autoFallbackModel` default false. docs + changelog must show examples.

samir (eng-sre): infra notes: 429 should include `quota_window` and `bucket_id` to debug noisy tenants. add a `x-request-trace` header on 5xx responses for immediate lookup. for 503 model-level we need a metric `model_unavailable_rate` per model variant and an alert at 0.5% over 5m during canary. also add circuit-breaker counts exposed to console.

elena (product): launch gates (must pass before GA):
- docs update with error matrix and client examples (owned: lisa)
- SDK release with typed errors + `shouldRetry` (owned: lisa)
- Console: per-error metrics and model_unavailable alerting (owned: samir)
- Canary: 24h canary with <0.5% model_unavailable and no more than 2% increased 95th latency (owned: jordan)
- Eval: run our prompt-suite to ensure fallback -> quality drop is within tolerance when autoFallbackModel=true (owned: pranay)
- Contract: public error codes list + `Retry-After` semantics documented (owned: elena)

jordan (eng): added quick test harness and a PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/432 that can simulate 400/429/503 flows and export traces. will add expected response bodies to the tests.

lisa (devex): timeline idea: docs + SDK changes in next minor (T+2 weeks), canary next week after infra flags. will add examples for chat vs embeddings vs function-calls — note: function-calls should include structured `diagnostics` since consumers may need to decide whether to retry the tool invocation.

pranay (eng-ml): for embeddings rerank flows: prefer deterministic non-retry for validation errors (bad input dims), but for rate/model failures we can queue-and-retry client-side with bounded TTL. add `retry_ttl_seconds` in response for guidance.

elena (product): decision points: 1) SDK auto-retry on 503? (opt-in only) 2) should we expose `available_variants` in GA? 3) how granular are error_codes? keep minimal for now.

jordan (eng): my votes: 1) opt-in. 2) yes, but only variant IDs and not infra details. 3) keep to ~8-12 codes to avoid churn.

lisa (devex): agree. smaller enum, stable names, semantic versioning for adding new codes. devs hate breaking changes. :thumbsup:

samir (eng-sre): one more: add deterministic `retry_after_ms` in body alongside HTTP header so clients behind proxies can still see it.

elena (product): ok. owners + deadlines:
- lisa: SDK + docs PRs by 1797720000 (Fri)
- jordan: tests and canary config by 1797700000 (Thu)
- samir: console alerts + metrics by 1797705000 (Thu afternoon)
- pranay: eval suite and fallback quality thresholds by 1797730000 (Sat)
- elena: publish contract doc and sample guidance by 1797740000 (Sun)

jordan (eng): noted. I'll also add a lightweight developer FAQ for edge cases (rate windows, short-lived quotas).

ops-bot: scheduled deploy window for canary flags: 1797727200 — will notify #eng-releases when toggled.

elena (product): great work. i'll consolidate the matrix into a single doc and link to PRs. if anyone hits blockers ping me directly. :rocket:
